title: Build 59-site competitive intelligence dataset
success_criteria: 59 named sites stored with canonical domain and evidence source
page-type, SEO/GEO, authority, conversion and portfolio fields populated or explicitly UNKNOWN
patterns and gaps trace back to source evidence
next_safe_action: Crawl and normalize the first evidence-backed competitor batch.

title: Map Murcia wedding demand and SERP intent graph
success_criteria: transactional, commercial, venue and informational queries classified
current SERP competitors and result types evidenced
query -> intent -> page-type -> goal mapping produced
next_safe_action: Capture high-intent Murcia photo/video wedding queries and current SERPs.

title: Establish canonical OASIS business entity truth
success_criteria: canonical brand, service area, contact, people and service facts separated from unknowns
every public claim has a durable evidence pointer
no invented experience, award, review, pricing or venue claim
next_safe_action: Inventory verified company facts and type unresolved fields as UNKNOWN.

title: Inventory permissioned wedding portfolio and film assets
success_criteria: candidate photo/film assets inventoried without copying private media into public Git
publication-rights status explicit per asset/wedding
venue/location/service relationships captured where evidenced
next_safe_action: Build a metadata-only inventory and permission status map.

title: Define evidence-backed offer and package architecture
success_criteria: Photography, Film and Photo+Film offer hierarchy defined
add-ons and qualification logic separated from unsupported pricing claims
offer maps directly to sales and website CTAs
next_safe_action: Synthesize competitor evidence and verified operating facts into the smallest viable offer.

title: Build Murcia venue and local authority graph
success_criteria: priority Murcia/Cartagena/Costa Calida venues mapped
venue pages are proposed only where unique evidence can exist
vendor/venue/PR relationship opportunities are evidence-backed
next_safe_action: Map high-value venues from current search demand and real portfolio evidence.

title: Freeze money-site information architecture
success_criteria: each planned indexable page has unique intent and evidence basis
money, venue, wedding, film and guide page types are connected by internal-link rules
no doorway-page expansion is accepted
next_safe_action: Reconcile the live web branch against competitor/SERP/entity evidence before freezing routes.

title: Establish AI-discovery benchmark and citation tracking
success_criteria: stable question set for AI-assisted search defined
brand mentions, cited URLs and competitors are recorded with date/engine
no claim is made that llms.txt or schema guarantees AI ranking
next_safe_action: Create the baseline query suite and measurement schema.

title: Define qualified-lead CRM pipeline and attribution contract
success_criteria: lead stages have explicit entry/exit semantics
source/campaign/landing/service/date/venue lineage is preserved
form submit, qualified lead and won contract remain distinct outcomes
next_safe_action: Define the minimum CRM state machine required by sales.

title: Define revenue-linked analytics event taxonomy
success_criteria: events cover portfolio, film, pricing, availability and sales transitions
event names/properties have one canonical meaning
measurement can connect landing/query/campaign to qualified lead and revenue
next_safe_action: Map website and CRM transitions into a minimal canonical event set.

title: Ship conversion-ready indexable OASIS web MVP
success_criteria: money pages render useful indexable HTML and real evidence-backed portfolio content
availability/contact conversion path works on mobile
SEO/accessibility/performance/analytics gates pass
next_safe_action: Reconcile and qualify the existing web-design branch against frozen IA, offer and portfolio truth.

title: Launch paid acquisition only against revenue-qualified funnel
success_criteria: campaign intent maps to dedicated relevant landing pages
qualified lead and won-contract feedback path exists
spend is not optimized merely for raw form submits
next_safe_action: Build high-intent Search campaigns only after conversion/CRM instrumentation is verified.

title: Mission Control v1 runtime bootstrap
success_criteria: runtime supports next/claim/heartbeat/release/bind-team-lead
single-writer collisions and stale recovery are tested
no live Team Lead is fabricated
next_safe_action: Promote runtime and bind a real Team Lead session only when an actual controller is running.
